name: The Pulse
developmental_beat: Rhythm and restraint: the body learns to spend and recover effort.

obstacles.role: membrane wall; its gap is readable but not physically moving
second membrane wall forcing a bend
timed damage band between the membranes
obstacles.fallback_until_implemented: Treat the band as inert wall geometry until timed damage is built.

upgrade.name: Energy for the burst
upgrade.softlock_fallback: Energy regenerates at 1/s with no pickups, so waiting always restores the burst.

boss.name: The Pulse Maw
boss.loop: Fires in three-beat clusters, then must inhale before the next cluster.
boss.weak_window: 1.4 s inhale after a cluster; bursts spent outside it are wasted.
boss.softlock_fallback: The Maw cannot be damaged while feeding, so no amount of stored energy can force the fight; health and energy refill at the shelter.
boss.fallback_until_implemented: Use the Rot Bloom's telegraph/exposed loop until the clustered attack is built.
boss.solution: Spend one energy per beat, then retreat through the membrane bend while it inhales.

narrative.beat: The sparse heartbeat becomes a rhythm the player can time movements against; it is never a threat.
